description.value: Fish With You is a Sichuan-inspired Chinese restaurant in Richmond specializing in fish-centric dishes including Sauerkraut Fish, Spicy Sichuan Fish Fillet, and Tomato Fish Soup. Diners receive unlimited steamed rice alongside customizable add-ins such as tofu, wood ear mushrooms, and vermicelli. The Richmond location on Alexandra Road is part of a two-branch chain also operating in Burnaby, offering both dine-in and online ordering through delivery platforms.
